title: stage masks: rift
shortDescription: Deep Listening: a radio-telescope control room at night and the same room drowned on the far side of the signal, two worlds through one living mask
description:
A `StageDirector` with the stack `[static, world, other, rim]`. The world is the control room of an old radio-telescope station at night — amber scopes, a tape recorder turning, cold coffee, the dish under the stars. The other world is the same room as it is wherever the signal comes from: drowned, overgrown with kelp, the dish a pulsing jellyfish, something enormous passing behind the window. The slot of `other` carries a mask: `director.setMask(other, new StageMask(membrane))`. Where the mask is 0 the world shows, where it is 1 the other world, in between a mix of both. The mask stage `membrane` is a `Stage2D` that draws the rift over transparent black: a torn outline with tendrils, worked out per pixel in TSL, breathing and flickering, and soft spores it buds at its rim. The rim of the rift glows in an unmasked layer on top.

*inverted second mask* puts a second `StageMask` on the **same** stage, `{invert: true}`, on the slot of the world: it cuts the world out where the rift is open, for the third layer below — pure static. The drowned room's reception rolls through in bands that leave its picture see-through, so through the rift you see the night room ghosting behind the water while the cut is off, and the static once it is on. Two `StageMask` objects on one stage are one mask stage: *membrane drawn* counts its draws, one per frame either way. *rift size* sets the radius of the membrane; *source* `luminance` reads the boil in the membrane's light and lets holes through. Move the rift with WASD, the arrow keys or a pointer drag; left alone, it drifts. See [Stage masks: a rift into a second world](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#a-rift-into-a-second-world) and [one mask on two slots](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#one-mask-on-two-slots).
